title: चारा और कीमतें चुनें
summary: आपके पास जो चारा है उसे चुनें और हर एक की कीमत डालें।

steps.text: डाइट रिकमेंडेशन चुनें (या अपनी मात्रा जाँचने के लिए इवैल्यूएशन)।
In Feed 1, pick the Feed Type, then the Category, then the Feed.
Type the price per kg in your currency.

Add more feeds. Include at least one forage.
Tip: the search box fills the selected card.

problems.title: "At least one forage is required"
problems.text: Add a feed whose type is Forage, then generate again.

problems.title: A feed is refused by name
problems.text: That feed has no dry-matter value. Pick another feed or create your own with a dry-matter value.
